cubes.text: The warmth of the sofa clings to you as you surface from a deep nap. Your eyelids flutter open, struggling against the flickering glow of the television. Slowly, the room comes into focus, revealing your {{dad}} with your little {{youngSister}} curled against him, both absorbed in the screen.

For a while, you don't move. You simply watch them from the corner of your half-shut eyes, feeling like an intruder in a peaceful moment. Then, careful not to disturb anything, you rise, pad quietly across the floor, and leave the living room without a word, letting the soft murmur of the TV continue undisturbed.
